source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of quantifiers in predicate logic (PDF 31-32).

blocks.text: Predicate logic mein quantifiers batate hain ke kitni ashya kisi shart ko poora karti hain. Yeh aam statements, ya khaas ashya ke baare mein statements, jaise 'Tamam talaba mehnati hain' ya 'Kuch kitabein dilchasp hain', banane dete hain. Quantifiers predicate logic ko propositional logic se zyada taqatwar banate aur ilm ko wazeh aur durust pesh karne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: 'For all' aur 'there exists' jaise quantifiers aam qawaid ya imkanat wazeh bayan karne mein madad dete hain.

blocks.caption: Do quantifiers
rows: Statement set ki har cheez ke liye sach
Tamam x ke liye, x > 0: har x 0 se bara
Statement set ki kam az kam aik cheez ke liye sach
Aisa x maujood hai jo jufat hai: kam az kam aik x jufat

blocks.text: Universal quantifier domain ki har cheez ke baare mein aam statements banata hai; yeh riyazi aur saboot (proofs) mein ahem hai, kyunke yeh kehta hai ke set ki koi cheez statement nahi torti. Existential quantifier tab use hota hai jab shart kuch cheezein poori karein, zaroori nahi sab; yeh imkanat aur khaas misalein bayan karta hai (Fig 2.8).

blocks.alt: Pandrah pandrah dairon ke do dabbe. Baen, universal alamat aur 'for all' wala: har daira sabz; caption: tamam x ke liye P(x), har x P poora karta. Daen, existential alamat aur 'there exists' wala: sirf aik daira sabz aur baqi khaali; caption: aisa x maujood hai ke P(x), kam az kam aik x P poora karta. Sabz ka matlab us cheez ke liye P(x) sach.
blocks.caption: Universal aur existential quantifiers (Fig 2.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: 'For all' ke liye har cheez ka paas hona zaroori hai; aik nakami ise jhoot kar deti hai. 'There exists' ke liye sirf aik cheez ka paas hona kafi hai.

blocks.text: Quantifiers predicates ke saath mil kar wazeh statements banate hain: 'tamam x ke liye P(x)' ka matlab har x ke liye P(x) sach, aur 'aisa x maujood hai ke P(x)' ka matlab kam az kam aik x ke liye P(x) sach. Yeh saath bhi use ho sakte hain: 'tamam x ke liye aisa y maujood hai ke y > x' ka matlab har number x ke liye koi number y us se bara hai.

blocks.prompt: Quantifier ki shakal mein likhein: (a) Class ka har talib-e-ilm pass hua. (b) Class ke kisi talib-e-ilm ne poore number liye.
blocks.explanation: (a) Tamam x ke liye, Student(x) -> Passed(x). (b) Aisa x maujood hai ke Student(x) AND FullMarks(x).

items: Quantifiers batate kitni ashya predicate poora karti hain.
Universal (ulta A): sab ke liye sach; existential (ulta E): kam az kam aik ke liye.
Inhein milaya ja sakta, jaise 'tamam x ke liye aisa y hai ke y > x'.
